_meta.name: forward_selection
_meta.description: Forward selection: REG_OLS with selection forward starts from the intercept and adds the candidate that improves AIC most, stopping when none does. On survey.pulse, q4 on the other five items adds q5, q3 and q6 (selected_features, in order) and never q1 or q2; compare 11_stepwise.json (both directions) and 14_backward_selection.json. Selection buffers the request.
